title: Conjugates of a glycoprotein or a glycan with a toxic payload
abstract: The invention relates to a glycoprotein-toxic pay-load molecule conjugate, a toxic payload molecule-glycan conjugate, and a pharmaceutical compos-ition. The invention further relates to a method for preparing the glycoprotein-toxic payload molecule conjugate, the method for modulating growth of a cell population and a method of treating tu-mour cells.
